left.title: Midre Qeranyo Midre Golgota
left.description: “Midre Qeranyo Midre Golgota” (Land of Calvary, Land of Golgotha) is an Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo spiritual hymn that reflects on the suffering, crucifixion, and ultimate sacrifice of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ for the salvation of humanity. The hymn recalls the pain Christ endured on the Cross at Golgotha, the shedding of His precious blood, and the extraordinary love, humility, and forgiveness He demonstrated even toward those who crucified Him. It invites believers to contemplate the mystery of the Holy Cross, recognize the depth of Christ’s sacrifice, and approach Him with repentance, gratitude, and faith. The hymn concludes with a heartfelt prayer for God's mercy, forgiveness, and everlasting guidance through the life-giving Body and Blood of Jesus Christ.

right.title: Selam Leki
right.description: This mezmur is a hymn of veneration to the Virgin Mary, greeting her with titles drawn from the Old Testament and sacred tradition. She is symbolically identified with holy objects and events such as Noah’s Ark, Aaron’s rod, Gideon’s fleece, Jacob’s ladder, and the manna of heaven—each pointing to her role in bearing Christ. The chant emphasizes her purity, divine selection, and her place as the Mother of God (Eme Egziabher).
